battleTraits.name: Holy Orders: Storm Charge
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.
battleTraits.effect: That unit can use Charge abilities this turn even if it used a Run ability in the same turn.
battleTraits.timingText: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase

battleTraits.name: Holy Orders: Shield of Azyr
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, that unit has Ward (5+).
battleTraits.timingText: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

regimentAbilities.name: Strike Where Needed
regimentAbilities.effect: Used by the unit using that Retreat ability: no mortal damage is inflicted on it by the Retreat, and it can still use Charge abilities this turn even though it retreated.
regimentAbilities.timingText: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a Retreat ability

regimentAbilities.name: Blaze of Glory
regimentAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat.
regimentAbilities.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit is slain, roll a D6: on a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit in combat with that unit.
regimentAbilities.timingText: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

enhancements.name: Morrda's Talon
enhancements.effect: Your general's Hallowed Greataxe has Crit (Mortal).

enhancements.name: Quicksilver Draught
enhancements.effect: Your general has Strike-First this phase.
enhancements.timingText: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

enhancements.name: Null Pendant
enhancements.declare: Roll a dice for each enemy unit contesting the same objective as your general.
enhancements.effect: On a 2+, subtract the roll from the control score of that enemy unit this turn.
enhancements.timingText: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn

abilities.name: Deliver Judgement
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. After the first is used, the target has Strike-Last for the rest of the phase.
abilities.timingText: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

abilities.name: Plan the Attack
abilities.declare: Pick an objective you do not control.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target enemy units contesting that objective.

abilities.name: Cleansing Fires
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit.

abilities.name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
abilities.effect: This unit's Gryph-crow is a token. This unit has Ward (5+) while its Gryph-crow is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove its Gryph-crow from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Heralds of Righteousness
abilities.effect: When you make a charge roll for this unit, roll 1 additional dice.

abilities.name: Skirmishers
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: Stalwart Defenders
abilities.effect: Add 3 to this unit's control score while it contests an objective wholly within friendly territory.
